allow_instructions: Prefer scripts/cursor_safe helpers over complex inline Python/PowerShell for verification.
Allow workspace Write/Edit/Create for normal source files inside Sotong24Work and SotongwareControl without Run prompts.
Allow safe in-repo Copy-Item / Move-Item / Rename-Item / New-Item inside Sotong24Work or SotongwareControl (explicit Work↔Control hook/config sync).
Allow read-only PowerShell inspection verbs and pipelines (Get-*, Test-Path, Select-*, Measure-*, Where-*, ForEach-*, Sort-*, Write-Host/Output) including Get-NetTCPConnection and Get-Process.
Allow git read commands including status/diff/log/show/rev-parse/rev-list/ls-files/ls-tree/describe/merge-base, git -C <allowed-root>, and compound read-only chains with Select-Object.
Allow explicit git add of related files and git commit. Keep git add . / -A gated.
Allow Flutter/Dart analyze, test (multi-file), format, pub get, devices, doctor, and local builds; allow analyze+test compounds.
Allow MSBuild/dotnet builds including full-path MSBuild.exe under Visual Studio (Release x64).
Allow controlled Stop-Process/Start-Process only for Sotong24Work_1st local Release verify — never broad process kill.
Allow only trusted python under scripts/cursor_safe/* and scripts/test_*.py / verify_*.py / test_unattended_ops_*.py after path containment. Never broad-allow Shell(python).
Allow HTTP GET/HEAD verification (Invoke-WebRequest/curl) for allowlisted hosts including localhost. Never auto POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE / --data / -d / -F.
block_instructions: Every production deploy or firebase deploy or scripts/deploy_control.ps1 execution must go through approval first.
Every git push, force push, reset, clean, stash, checkout --, restore, worktree remove must go through approval first.
Every bulk delete (Remove-Item/rm) must go through approval first.
Never auto-approve STEP15/STEP18/Golden Run/START_JOB/new WI transfer.
Never auto-approve Write outside Sotong24Work/SotongwareControl (SotongwareWeb stays gated).
Never auto-approve python -c / python -m / arbitrary scripts/*.py / HTTP write / redirect to secrets.
failClosed=true — UNKNOWN must ask, never auto-allow.
